lessons.failure: Bend diagnostic errors can be emitted on stderr while successful checks use stdout.
lessons.reproducer: Run a PROOF.bend with a missing required proof and capture both streams.
lessons.reopen: The compiler changes its diagnostic transport contract.
lessons.consequence: Parse both streams and reject errors even if stdout contains a success event.

lessons.failure: Syntactically valid JSON can still have the wrong object shape.
lessons.reproducer: Supply [] as the evidence object or metric registry.
lessons.reopen: A new external document shape or schema version is accepted.
lessons.consequence: Validate schema shape before field access and preserve the structured error envelope.

lessons.failure: A measurement subprocess can silently observe a different state than the parent.
lessons.reproducer: Select an alternate journal while the default journal is corrupt.
lessons.reopen: A new subprocess, state selector, or remote measurement adapter is introduced.
lessons.consequence: Forward the selected state and verify its returned head before attributing measurements.

lessons.failure: A verifier exposed its final evidence path before execution completed.
lessons.reproducer: During verification, require the final evidence path to remain absent.
lessons.reopen: Evidence publication moves to a different filesystem or remote object store.
lessons.consequence: Publish only complete fsynced evidence through a no-overwrite atomic operation; preserve interrupted pending records.
